message.content:
Fix two components in this Next.js marketing site at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq:

## Fix 1: Rebuild CtaBanner to match Webflow .blue-sec + .book-section structure

**File:** src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx

**Current:** Plain navy section with inline style `padding: "40px 20px 50px"`, no wrapper, no border-radius.

**Required structure (from Webflow CSS):**
```
.blue-sec (outer section)
  background-color: transparent
  margin-bottom: 70px
  padding: 0 5%
  position: relative

  .book-section (inner card)
    background-color: #082753
    background-image: url('/images/webflow/Mask-group-1.png')
    background-position: 100% 100%
    background-repeat: no-repeat
    background-size: auto
    border-radius: 20px
    padding: 40px 20px 50px
    max-width: 1280px
    margin: 0 auto
```

The component accepts these props (keep same interface):
- title (string, default: "Ready to Deliver This Level of Work Under Your Brand?")
- subtitle (string)
- primaryCta ({ label, href })
- secondaryCta ({ label, href })

Rebuild the JSX with the two-div nested structure. Use inline styles (no CSS module needed for this simple component). The inner card content should be centered text with white heading, white/60% subtitle, and two buttons (gradient primary + outline secondary). Match button styles from OurWorksCta:
- Primary btn: `background: linear-gradient(90deg, #21cfff, #019ae6); color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 28px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;`
- Secondary btn: `background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 28px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center;`

Content inside card: centered, h2 (40px, white, Roobert PRO, line-height 45px), subtitle (16px, rgba(255,255,255,0.7), margin-top 16px, max-width 600px), buttons row (flex, justify-center, gap 12px, margin-top 32px).

Remove the ArrowRight/lucide-react import since we won't use ButtonLink anymore.

## Fix 2: Fix OurWorksCta background image

**File:** src/components/our-works/our-works-cta.module.css

Find this line:
```css
background-image: url('/images/webflow/Union.svg');
```

Change to:
```css
background-image: url('/images/webflow/Mask-group-1.png');
```

The file `/images/webflow/Mask-group-1.png` exists in public/images/webflow/.

Read both files before editing them.

Build passes with zero errors. Both changes are in place:

**Fix 1 — `src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx`**
- Dropped `ArrowRight` and `ButtonLink` imports entirely
- Outer `<section>` now carries the `.blue-sec` styles: `backgroundColor: transparent`, `marginBottom: 70px`, `padding: 0 5%`
- Inner `<div>` carries the `.book-section` styles: `#082753` background, `Mask-group-1.png` at `100% 100%`, `borderRadius: 20px`, `padding: 40px 20px 50px`, `maxWidth: 1280px`, centered
- Heading: 40px, weight 700, line-height 45px, white, Roobert PRO
- Subtitle: 16px, `rgba(255,255,255,0.7)`, maxWidth 600px, centered
- Buttons: plain `<Link>` tags with the exact gradient primary and outline secondary inline styles matching OurWorksCta
- Buttons row: `flexWrap: wrap` so it collapses correctly on mobile

**Fix 2 — `src/components/our-works/our-works-cta.module.css`**
- Single line change: `Union.svg` replaced with `Mask-group-1.png` — both cards now use the same background image asset.
